parameters.formDescription: Upload all of this week's tvm-overdue Excel files for an AI-written HTML report.

parameters.completionMessage: Your TVM weekly report is downloading.

parameters.content:
## Weekly AI report (upload the week's files -> HTML)

Upload a week of dated `tvm-overdue` Excel files; download an HTML report: an AI-written
five-paragraph summary (one per owner) plus a per-owner table with clickable ticket links.

**Flow:** uses the earliest and latest file (first vs last day). n8n computes all numbers;
Azure OpenAI only writes the prose, so figures never drift.

**Setup:** on the "Azure OpenAI Chat Model" node, pick your Azure AI Foundry credential,
Project, and chat deployment (e.g. gpt-4o). Run via the form URL (not Execute step).

**Table columns:** Owner, Start, End, Net, Currently overdue, New this week, Cleared this week
(ticket cells are comma-separated clickable links from the Ticket URL column).
